Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance

Claim Notes
Claim number:

Darin Tyler
05/02/2025
Claim received for a collision in which the insured vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The claimant
reports a shoulder injury and is not represented by an attorney.
05/22/2025
Reviewed the photographs submitted with the first notice of loss. They show damage consistent with the described
impact, and the repair estimate lines up with the areas affected.
07/16/2025
Spoke with the claimant, who gave the same account of the collision as in the initial report. Confirmed through the
police report and a witness statement that the claimant was seated in the vehicle at the time.
07/18/2025
The claimant's medical records describe a shoulder injury that fits the kind and force of this crash. Treatment has
continued somewhat longer than is typical for this injury, so the file will be monitored.
07/21/2025
No prior injury to the same shoulder appears in the claimant's history or in available records. Requested prior claims
history to confirm.
08/06/2025
No independent witnesses to the collision have come forward, and the photographs are the only independent
confirmation of the details at this stage.
10/01/2025
A neighbor mentioned seeing the car with damage some weeks before the reported loss date. Noted the commnet for
follow-up, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is currently on record.
12/07/2025
The driver lives with the policyholder and qualifies as a covered household member under the policy. Coverage
confirmed, and the file remains open pending the neighbor follow-up and final medical review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
